label: Teltonika TAP200
description: A dual-band Wi-Fi 5 access point: one gigabit RJ45 with PoE-in, fast roaming and a hotspot portal. The step up from the TAP100 is the 5 GHz radio and the gigabit port.
notes: Vendor figures from the TAP200 datasheet: 1 x RJ45 10/100/1000 Mbps with PoE-in; dual-band Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac). The radios are modelled at the standard 2x2 rates for that standard - 300M on 2.4 GHz and 867M on 5 GHz - because the datasheet names the standard rather than a per-band client rate.
